dcterms:description: This dataset contains 49 Hoechst-stained images with a size of 1344x1024 pixels, including 2212 cell nuclei. It is challenging due to strong auto-fluorescence artifacts, visible debris, significant intensity inhomogeneities, and many closely clustered or partially overlapping cell nuclei.
dcterms:title: NIH3T3 dataset

dcterms:description: This dataset consists of 48 images of U2OS cells stained with Hoechst 33342, each with a size of 1349x1030 pixels, including 1836 cell nuclei. The dataset is challenging due to frequent occurrences of strongly non-elliptical and closely clustered cell nuclei.
dcterms:title: U2OS dataset

dcterms:description: This dataset consists of two datasets of GFP-transfected mouse embryonic stem cells from the IEEE ISBI Cell Tracking Challenge training data, where each image has a size of 1024x1024 pixels. The datasets include temporal image sequences with 31 images (150 cell nuclei) and 20 images (128 cell nuclei), respectively. The dataset is challenging due to low signal-to-noise ratio, low image contrast, and cell nucleoli.
dcterms:title: GOWT1 datasets

dcterms:description: This dataset contains 175 3-D stacks of 35–50 DAPI-stained images of human Fibroblast cells, with each image having a size of 1024x1024 pixels. The dataset includes 985 cell nuclei and is challenging due to partially strong intensity inhomogeneities of the cell nuclei.
dcterms:title: Fibroblast dataset

dcterms:description: This dataset consists of 25 DAPI-stained HeLa images, each containing 282 cell nuclei, with image sizes of 1200x1620 pixels. It is used for evaluating segmentation performance.
dcterms:title: HeLa dataset
